quotes.text: NS_WARNING("uid validity seems to have changed, blowing away db");

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The patch replaces a kUidUnknown-conditioned assertion with a warning inside the UID-validity mismatch branch. It leaves the database backup/recreation, validity/reset markers and fresh-fetch work in place. The fixed accepted source moves that work into HandleUidInvalidation and keeps the warning at entry. This is a diagnostic/control-flow observation, not proof that invalidation, offline-copy intermittents or debug failures are cured.
title: The UID-validity warning leaves the invalidation branch in place
